answer: Anchor each identity to one unique public portfolio: a domain or code repository at least 30 days old, proven by a DNS TXT record or signed commit history, and lock 80 POA. Each epoch it must publish three new work items tied to that anchor. The chain rejects any anchor already claimed, so a farm cannot forge ten identities from one portfolio: it needs ten aged anchors, ten domains, and 800 POA locked. Copied histories leave a whisper of identical timestamps, while public logs act as a lantern, letting anyone verify DNS records, signatures, and anchor age.
